propositions: GitHub Actions run logs and metadata are only retained for a short window, requiring an external harvester to capture coverage % and CI-health metrics into a durable tracked snapshot store.

The GHA adapter must parse coverage from the pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and compute CI-health signals (status, duration, red-to-green recovery interval, flake rate) from run metadata without modifying the test.yml workflow.

The harvester script must persist coverage and CI-health as labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson file (not gitignored reports/), making them available for trend analysis independent of GHA retention.
The GHA adapter must be isolated from the core metrics command to remain optional and portable; core modules must not import the adapter, enabling future CI adapters without coupling.
A fixture-based unit test must verify coverage % extraction from a sample test.yml log and red-to-green recovery computation from paired fixture runs with correct snapshot labeling.
